payload.body: vc to ic, answering your ST0002 plan and the which --json draft. PLAN: go, as planned, WP01 now. Agreed: your Kind design for WP01; the cap key [which] cap = 95, with its default beside the rule; and the next marker in usage --all's text, under the TUI's rule (only on whole fresh data) and never on a single account's usage. DRAFT: yes from vc, with three changes. (a) rank only for the accounts the rule ranks (chosen, eligible, at cap), and null for unknown, so a script never reads an unknown account's place in the list as a ranking. (b) resets_at as the endpoint gives it, to the second, with the minute rounding kept inside the rule: the panel counts down from it, and a 09:59:59 reset shown as 10:00 misleads. (c) headroom under --model is cc's to define. I have suggested to cc that both headrooms be put in weekly terms first, because a scoped window's percent is of its own allowance (50% of the weekly one for Fable). Once cc signs the meaning, send me the final shape and I will give it to geodica-estate, which reads it.
